# Skips that a test run may report. One entry per line:
#   platform package test # reason
# The platform is linux, darwin, windows or *. An entry allows a skip and does
# not require it. A test may be added only with a reason that holds in review.
# TestRecoveryWithStandardTools is deliberately absent: it must run everywhere.

*       bw-takeout/internal/publish        TestKillHelper                          # helper process of TestProcessKilledWhileWriting, reports a skip when run on its own
*       bw-takeout/cmd/bw-takeout    TestLeaveGenerationForOfflineExercise   # opt-in for the manual offline exercise, needs its environment variables
*       bw-takeout/internal/bwcli          TestRealBWVersionAndHash                # opt-in, needs BW_TAKEOUT_REAL_BW and contacts Bitwarden Cloud, run by hand in the dev container
*       bw-takeout/internal/bwcli          TestRealBWStatusWithoutLogin            # opt-in, needs BW_TAKEOUT_REAL_BW and contacts Bitwarden Cloud, run by hand in the dev container
*       bw-takeout/internal/bwcli          TestRealBWNotLoggedIn                   # opt-in, needs BW_TAKEOUT_REAL_BW and contacts Bitwarden Cloud, run by hand in the dev container
*       bw-takeout/internal/bwcli          TestRealBWCleanExitInCallingEnvironment # opt-in, needs BW_TAKEOUT_REAL_BW and contacts Bitwarden Cloud, run by hand in the dev container
*       bw-takeout/internal/bwcli          TestRealBWLoginWithoutTerminal          # opt-in, needs BW_TAKEOUT_REAL_BW and contacts Bitwarden Cloud, run by hand in the dev container
linux   bw-takeout/internal/crashdump      TestRealLimitHelper                     # helper process of TestRealLimit, reports a skip when run on its own
darwin  bw-takeout/internal/crashdump      TestRealLimitHelper                     # helper process of TestRealLimit, reports a skip when run on its own
*       bw-takeout/internal/run            TestCrashDumpHelper                     # helper process of the real-path crash dump tests, reports a skip when run on its own
linux   bw-takeout/internal/run            TestRunOnWindows                        # checks the Windows stub of crashdump.Limit, runs in the Windows CI job
darwin  bw-takeout/internal/run            TestRunOnWindows                        # checks the Windows stub of crashdump.Limit, runs in the Windows CI job
darwin  bw-takeout/internal/run            TestRunProcessNotDumpable               # the not-dumpable mark exists on Linux only
windows bw-takeout/internal/run            TestRunProcessNotDumpable               # the not-dumpable mark exists on Linux only
windows bw-takeout/internal/run            TestBWInheritsTheLimit                  # Windows has no core file size limit, crashdump.Limit changes nothing there
windows bw-takeout/internal/run            TestLimitSetBeforeTheFirstBWProcess     # Windows has no core file size limit, crashdump.Limit changes nothing there
windows bw-takeout/internal/publish        TestPermissionsOnLinux                  # Windows has no POSIX permissions, access control lists are a non-goal
windows bw-takeout/internal/profile        TestPermissionsOnLinuxAndMacOS          # Windows has no POSIX permissions, access control lists are a non-goal
windows bw-takeout/cmd/bw-takeout    TestSystemWithoutBW                     # the empty search path is tested on Unix only
windows bw-takeout/internal/offline       TestPartialGenerationByAnotherPath      # needs symbolic links, which an unprivileged Windows user may not create
